passage:
The school soccer game was planned for Friday afternoon. Students talked about it all week. Some made signs. Others practiced cheering.
But on Friday, heavy rain began before lunch. The playground became wet, and the game had to be canceled. Many students were disappointed.
Then the PE teacher had another idea. He moved the event to the gym and changed soccer into a simple ball-passing game. Each class sent ten players. The rules were easy, and even students who did not play soccer could join.
The new game was not what everyone expected, but the gym was full of shouting and laughter. At the end, the teacher said, "Rain changes plans, not fun."
